name: Make
tagline: Make (formerly Integromat) is a visual automation platform that connects apps and services through flowchart-style diagrams, handling everything from simple data transfers to multi-step workflows with conditional logic. Its extensive library of 1,700+ integrations includes AI tools like OpenAI and Google Gemini as native modules. Non-technical users build sophisticated automations that eliminate repetitive manual tasks between business tools.
